What if I will not be available to receive my shipment? 
Most of our shipments contain valuable items, so our carriers are required to obtain a signature upon delivery. However. 
orders delivered by Postal Service do not require a signature. If you are unable to sign for delivery. the carrier will leave a 
calling card. You can then contact the carrier directly to schedule a new delivery appointment or alternatively amend your 
delivery address. 
For more information about Apple's delivery options, visit online Help.

separate shipments with no additional shipping charges. For more information about shipping or returns, please visit online 
Help.
You can also contact your Business Team with any questions.

Questions 
What if I won't be available to receive my shipment? 
Most of our shipments contain valuable items, so our 
carriers are required to obtain a signature upon delivery. If 
you are unable to sign for delivery, the carrier will leave a 
calling card. You can then contact the carrier directly to 
schedule a new delivery appointment or alternatively amend 
your delivery address. 
Orders delivered by postal service do not require a 
signature. 
For more information about Apple's delivery options, visit 
online Help. 
How do I track my shipment? 
Visit online Order Status 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, to 
view the most up-to-date status of your order. View the 
details of your order including how to track your delivery and 
carrier details. 
You can also call Apple Store Customer Service on 0800 
048 0408 (low rate), Mon-Fri 8:00 - 21:00, Sat—Sun 9:00 -
18:00. 
Can I withdraw from the contract?

0408 (low rate), or visit online Order Status to arrange your 
return. More details on the right of withdrawal are set out in 
the terms and conditions of the Apple Online Store.

Frequently Asked Questions 
What if I will not be available to receive my shipment? 
Most of our shipments contain valuable items, so our carriers are required to obtain a signature upon delivery. However. 
orders delivered by Postal Service do not require a signature. If you are unable to sign for delivery. the carrier will leave a 
calling card. You can then contact the carrier directly to schedule a new delivery appointment or alternatively amend your 
delivery address. 
For more information about Apple's delivery options, visit online Help.
How do I track my shipment? 
Visit online Order Status to view the most up-to-date status of your order. If you ordered multiple items, you may receive 
separate shipments with no additional shipping charges. For more information about shipping or returns, please visit online 
Help.
You can also contact your Business Team with any questions.

Questions 
What if I won't be available to receive my shipment? 
Most of our shipments contain valuable items, so our 
carriers are required to obtain a signature upon delivery. If 
you are unable to sign for delivery, the carrier will leave a 
calling card. You can then contact the carrier directly to 
schedule a new delivery appointment or alternatively 
amend your delivery address. 
Orders delivered by postal service do not require a 
signature. 
For more information about Apple's delivery options, visit 
online Help. 
How do I track my shipment? 
Visit online Order Status 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, to 
view the most up-to-date status of your order. View the 
details of your order including how to track your delivery 
and carrier details. 
You can also call Apple Store Customer Service on 0800 
048 0408 (low rate), Mon-Fri 8:00 - 21:00, Sat-Sun 9:00 -
18:00. 
Can I withdraw from the contract? 
If you change your mind, please contact us at 0800 048 
0408 (low rate), or visit online Order Status to arrange your 
return. More details on the right of withdrawal are set out in 
the terms and conditions of the Apple Online Store.
